_note: Who s.127 does not take as a dependant: one who claims the deduction for their own disability (W-156h, D-354; W-156g). TY 2026-27: Income-tax Act, 2025 s.127(8), not a dependant who claimed s.154 (as DED-DISABLED-DEPENDANT's note quotes it). TY 2025-26: Income-tax Act, 1961 s.80DD Explanation (b), whose "dependant" ends "and who has not claimed any deduction under section 80U in computing his total income for the assessment year relating to the previous year" (thc p.344; docs/taxplanning-build/sources/2026-10-24-dependant.md D1). s.128 and 1961 s.80DDB have no such bar (D2; s.128(5)(a) takes s.127(9) only), which is why this is a row of its own rather than a condition on DED-DEPENDANT. Reached by the dependant's dependant.claims.own.disability; a dependant it does not reach is refused for s.127. Conditions only; provenance and introduction are DED-DEPENDANT's. Old regime only, as those rows.

introducedBy.instrumentCitation: Finance Act, 2022 (6 of 2022), s.21 — s.80DD(2)(a), (3A) (the scheme's payout); s.80DD(1) as subs. by Act 20 of 2015, s.20 (w.e.f. 1-4-2016)
